title: fix(sessions): human steering waits behind queued native turns
body:
Related: #191717

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes human corrections waiting behind a queued native agent turn while the current agent continues working.

## User Impact

Compatible human steering can reach the active agent's next model request without waiting for an older native input already committed to a separate turn. The older native turn keeps its FIFO position and executes once. No configuration changes or migration are required.

## Why This Change Was Made

Permanent native task claims retained an injection opportunity until turn selection, although an active incumbent prevents selection. Release the existing injection-order receipt at permanent commitment, matching the existing followup contract. Turn selection, source custody, final authority checks, cancellation and uncertain-delivery non-replay remain unchanged; speculative declined claims are untouched.

This repairs a reproduced current-main starvation path. The original incident's precise blocking owner remains unproven; this does not attribute its long admission delay to an authority mismatch or provider failure.

## Evidence

- Reviewed and tested source: base `97e996675b41f0c2d18d7cd51a5cfc32982c1306`, head `dfde4e45e6284964a0c43150d1502ad27dc35b8b`, tree `e96b9557cff2d46faf11876d927610f7238751cd`. Published head `4c3b406907d08e660798a834652b05d2497c72a1` is a source-identical metadata-only child; the complete source diff is empty.
- Final human-input regression fails on pristine base at the second model request: tool completion occurs but the correction is absent. The identical fixture passes with the repair.
- 139 selected tests pass: complete stream suite 42/42 plus 97 FIFO/custody/admission/cancellation siblings. `pnpm test src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/attempt-stream-prepare.test.ts --maxWorkers=1`: 41.06s command wall including cold worker preparation; siblings 39.25s. New regression 255ms on base.
- Local reviewed-head production core types, all 29 selected canonical test type graphs, targeted typed lint, formatting, whitespace, test-line and assertion-safety ratchets pass. Production +4 lines; test +105 with per-change allocation, shared baseline unchanged.
- Exact-head [CI run 41599577845](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/41599577845) is **failed**, not green: ratchet job `125795438378` fails only test-lines, and aggregate `125798280056` reports that failure. Other jobs passed or were intentionally skipped; no cancellation coverage is claimed. All nine other baseline ratchets passed.
- Owning-gate reproduction on exact generated CI merge `54a741f4db3cc6808f463e97bdfce05ce020066d`, using `--base 31ad71a8addc1d42fbc5478f7e114860f5cbf6c7 --no-merge-base`, reproduces exit 1: total 6,422,283; ceiling 6,422,277; over by 6; net delta +105. The unchanged pinned base against its parent also fails the same gate: total 6,422,178; ceiling 6,422,172; over by 6; net delta +283. Against itself, the pinned base reports that same overage but intentionally exits 0 because delta is zero. These are distinct results, not blanket passing coverage. The PR adds 105 net test lines and allocation 105, leaving inherited six-line debt unchanged; no ceiling inflation, assertion removal, or unrelated baseline repair is included. Native inherited-failure admission remains subject to live policy/security/review checks.
- Real isolated Gateway + built-in OpenClaw runtime + real model comparison on [Blacksmith Testbox](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/41597453841): baseline correction stays pending across five genuine model/tool boundaries. Correctly rebuilt candidate applies the unique correction before parent barrier release, records the exact user correction once, removes pending custody, then executes the older native turn exactly once after the parent. Native workload exit 0; candidate live test 22.527s / command 58.816s. Actions lease cancellation during cleanup is not the workload result.
- Executable input signatures: baseline `5d66eed389eaee8c9e90e7f93508bdf3592b37acaf068d8ef873d4e6ecb7c86b`; candidate `9fe3de8db4cdfa54d95823224bdeba024b56a40b08120dec66f566b91487b967`. Temporary live probe is outside published source.
- Qualified full local ClawSweeper review at pinned source `7af0b3df82e30c661bd041fa09216724b3587658`, full `dist/clawsweeper-local.js` committed-range review for openclaw/openclaw, exact base/head/tree above. Hannes independently verified clean runner/target before and after; completed status, no findings, correctness/security cleared. Report SHA-256 `22d0f60699de2e2bbc2a0de7579cf5d6b092fca0bdb05a22a41f72e999e8982e`. Its then-open live-proof limitation is addressed by the completed comparison; no reviewed source changed. No duplicate review requested.

<details>
<summary>Redacted runtime trace and failed setup evidence</summary>

Candidate: injection predecessor waiting/settled at 07:53:11.871 UTC; injection outcome consumed at 07:53:14.158; unique correction action observed at 07:53:15.814 while barrier held; barrier released at 07:53:15.815; parent transcript index 12, native reply index 14, nativeReplies=1. Isolated Gateway cleanup confirmed.

Earlier setup failures remain recorded, not passing proof or product verdicts: forbidden host-HOME override, host artifact-publication permissions, fixture-owned port, legacy fixture config, reused baseline executable, and an incorrect assertion that direct transcript promotion retains a consumed pending-row receipt. Corrected proof follows the actual direct-promotion contract; product publication/port/authority guards were preserved.

</details>
